title: Brown spent his career looking for a nuclear power source

tellings.quote: the funny thing about Brown is he was looking for a power source that was nuclear for like the rest of his career.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that a researcher named Townsend Brown, known for experiments aimed at controlling gravity, spent the rest of his career searching for a nuclear power source. Michels finds this telling because it suggests Brown believed his devices needed far more power than ordinary sources could give.
